data.one_liner: Polymorphic JSON (de)serialization using json_serializable with type info.
data.what_it_does: Extends json_serializable to support polymorphic classes by adding a __type field and a registry of fromJson functions. It re-exports uuid for ID generation.
use_when: You need to serialize/deserialize class hierarchies to/from JSON
You already use json_serializable and want minimal boilerplate for polymorphism
You need unique IDs in your models
avoid_when: You only need simple flat JSON models
You prefer runtime reflection over code generation
strengths: Adds polymorphic support with minimal extra code
Re-exports uuid for convenient ID generation
Provides graceful fallback for unknown types
weaknesses: Adds extra registration step at startup
No support for other serialization formats
data.setup_notes: Add carp_serializable and json_annotation to dependencies, build_runner and json_serializable to dev_dependencies, run build_runner to generate code, register classes in FromJsonFactory before use.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides code generation for immutable value types and polymorphic serialization via @BuiltValueSerializerPlugin

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers code generation for immutable classes with union types and JSON support
